mission_summary: Built the finite deterministic Wave-0 V553→V558 semantic continuity fixture/test harness in an isolated test namespace. The reference contract exercises all five fixed vertical slices, separates artifact-shape success from semantic preservation, fails on information loss and forbidden direct-persona inference, and records current production gaps as strict XFAILs rather than inventing unresolved stage semantics.

authorized_implementation.summary: Added only isolated test/fixture infrastructure and worker reports. No production semantic code in V553–V558 or V550–V552J was modified.

findings.evidence: VS1 strict XFAIL: V553 exposes typed temporal observations/keys/deltas/gaps/rupture candidates, but current V555 mediation does not guarantee preservation of temporal relation/key identity through downstream stages.
findings.required_behavior: Carry stable temporal relation/key identity and typed temporal state through mediation, pressure-flow, renderer, and runtime-input boundaries without reconstructing it from generic slots.
findings.recommended_owner: Wave-1 V555 mediation owner with V554 handoff coordination

findings.evidence: VS2 strict XFAIL: V554 can carry contradiction IDs, while V555 reduces downstream mediation to seed IDs/unresolved slots; distinct opposing pressure identities and signs are not guaranteed to survive.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve named source pressure IDs, direction/sign, conflict-set identity, and authority provenance across the V554→V555→V556 handoff.

findings.evidence: VS3 strict XFAIL plus reference loss detector: current V555 exposes mediation topology but no typed BUFFER/AMPLIFY condition/effect relation against named source pressures.
findings.required_behavior: Emit bounded typed mediation conditions/effects with stable condition IDs, target pressure IDs, effect kind, magnitude/uncertainty, and provenance; V556 must consume rather than invent them.

findings.evidence: VS4 strict XFAIL: V556 exposes generic candidate route axes and attractor requirements, but stable route/prerequisite identity tied to mediated pressures/conditions is not guaranteed across the renderer boundary.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve stable flow-route IDs, source mediation/pressure/condition IDs, and prerequisite-only status through V557/V558; never promote prerequisites into finished psyche or personality type.
findings.recommended_owner: Wave-1 V556 owner with V557 handoff coordination

findings.evidence: VS5 strict XFAIL: current stages separately represent absence/prohibition and block runtime leakage, but do not guarantee uncertainty, absence, noncomparability, and authority provenance survive as one typed semantic chain into V558.
findings.required_behavior: Carry uncertainty, ABSENT, NONCOMPARABLE, blockers, and authority/provenance as distinct typed states to the runtime-input gate; never coerce absence/noncomparability to zero/neutral or infer missing authority.

tests.notes: 12 passed, 5 xfailed in 0.11s. The five strict XFAILs are intentional current-production semantic gaps, one per fixed vertical slice.
